notes.title: Demo version update and bug fix
notes.content:
Demo version update and bug fix guide



Errors found after the BIC exhibition, puzzle-related play convenience, and additional icons have been made.



Sound and directional updates are scheduled, and we are planning to get it done as soon as possible. I hope the demo version looks the best from scratch, but I don't think so.



But I'm going to do my best to get closer to him. Bye!



_ tinynap
